summary: Assess AI suppliers, draft contract controls and plan monitoring. Build practical procurement skills; enquire about this five-day course.
lede: Responsible AI procurement training helps procurement leaders, contract managers, legal counsel and technology or risk professionals assess AI suppliers and define accountable controls. It covers screening use cases and reviewing supplier evidence, including model and dataset documentation, then translating findings into data and model clauses, acceptance tests and monitoring plans. Participants practise building due-diligence scorecards, assigning risk owners and planning human oversight and incident reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who specify, buy, contract for, implement or oversee AI systems in public-sector and corporate environments. You will work on responsibilities that connect procurement decisions to supplier evidence, contractual controls and operational monitoring.
modules: NIST AI RMF and Procurement Scope
Model Cards and Data Contract Clauses
prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one of procurement, contracting, legal review, risk management, IT delivery or AI programme operations is expected. No coding or model-building experience is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for the spreadsheet-based procurement register exercises.
